newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-RECORD ROUNDS FOR FROST AND WADE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-RECORD ROUNDS FOR FROST AND WADE.

text.p: David Frost of South Africa and Australian John Wade fired course record-equalling 65s to share the lead before thunderstorms curtailed the second round of the Dimension Data Pro-Am tournament on Friday.

Half the field were still to complete their rounds when play was called off for the day with Frost and Wade 10 under par on 134, two shots ahead of Ireland's Padraig Harrington who had a second round 66.
The tournament is being played over two courses at the gambling and holiday resort, the Gary Player Country Club and the Lost City course.
Frost, a three-times winner of the Sun City Million Dollar Challenge, and Wade were playing on the Lost City course.
Zimbabwe's Mark McNulty also carded a 66 at Lost City to be in joint fourth place on 137 with Iain Pyman of Britain who had a 67.
Overnight leader Ronnie McCann of South Africa followed his 65 at Lost City with a disappointing one over par 73 at the Country Club to share sixth place with four others on 138.
The second round will be completed on Saturday morning with the third round following at the Country Club.
